messages:
Maria (CS): FYI incoming request from Lumina Health — they want to onboard a 13B summarizer for clinical notes, must support PHI handling (HIPAA), HSM for keys, and a private VPC deployment. Tight latency target: p95 < 200ms. Renewal for their gov contract is in ~6 weeks so they want pricing & a path to Dedicated or Private ASAP. Can we scope safety eval + infra options?

Derek (CS): Ack. Do we have sample notes and target PII/PHI list from them? Also want to flag renewal timeline as a potential churn risk if we miss it.

Maria (CS): They sent a small sample set via secure share earlier today (link in ticket). PHI types: patient name, MRN, SSN, procedure codes. They asked about quantized models and whether quantization affects PHI masking.

Ian (ML Eng): Short answer: quantization alone shouldn't change masking behavior if we keep evals. Recommend q4_K_M or q5 if GPU supports it; keep a non-quantized fallback in rollout. Need a determinism check on redaction outputs across model variants.

Amy (SRE): For p95 <200ms on 13B we need Dedicated GPUs + KV cache warm policy. If they want VPC private, we should plan for Dedicated Private nodes or on-prem. What's their concurrency?

Maria (CS): They said baseline concurrency 8 sustained, burst to 30. SLA expectation is 99.9 for uptime.

Ian (ML Eng): Ok. Proposed ML checklist: 1) safety eval suite (PHI extraction + false redaction rate), 2) prompt robustness tests (typos, truncated context), 3) regression tests against baseline prompts, 4) stress with prefix cache disabled/enabled. Example eval command for quick run:

```
# run local eval harness
python eval/harness.py --model ./models/lumina-13b --dataset samples/lumina_phI_tests.jsonl --metrics redaction_precision,redaction_recall,fluency
```

Ian (ML Eng): We'll need 500 labeled examples for a reliable redaction recall estimate. Can CS ask for a de-identified labeled subset first?

Derek (CS): I'll request the 500-labeled subset and ask legal to confirm sharing method. Also looping in billing — they want cost estimate for Dedicated vs Private + HSM add-on.

onboard-bot: checklist created: [intake_form, sample_data_received, security_req_flagged, eval_request_created]. Next step: assign eval ticket to eng-ml.

Amy (SRE): Capacity note: with concurrency 30 and p95 <200ms, plan is 4 x A100-equivalent nodes with autoscale to 6 for bursts, plus a small redis KV cache cluster. If they insist on on-prem, we need specs for their infra team.

Ian (ML Eng): For rollout strategy: canary at 5% traffic -> 25% -> 100% with automatic fallback to 7B compressed model if latency SLO violated. Also enable prefix caching for repeated transcripts.

Maria (CS): Great. Action items:
- Derek: request 500 labeled PHI samples + confirm secure transfer method (due EOD tomorrow)
- Ian: draft safety eval plan & quick-run script (ETA 48h)
- Amy: draft infra capacity estimate + Dedicated vs Private comparison (ETA 48h)
- Derek/Maria: cost and renewal brief for customer-facing proposal (ETA 3 business days)

Derek (CS): On it. I'll ping Legal about the transfer method and start drafting the cost sheet.

Ian (ML Eng): I'll scaffold the eval ticket with required metrics and add regression prompt set. Will attach a small seed job to run on a dev GPU for initial numbers.

Amy (SRE): I'll put together the node sizing and a rough cost delta for Dedicated vs Private + HSM. Also list networking reqs for VPC peering.

Maria (CS): Thanks all. Scheduling an enablement call with Lumina for Friday 10am PT. I'll post invite once Derek confirms sample access. :calendar: :rocket:

Derek (CS): Heads-up — renewal owner flagged this as high priority, I'll escalate if we don't have cost/infra within 72h.

Maria (CS): Noted. If any blockers, add to this thread and I'll escalate to AE.

Ian (ML Eng): Quick note: include a small perf matrix comparing q4_K vs fp16 for token cost & latency in the eval doc.

Maria (CS): Will do. Closing loop here for now, keeping thread for updates.
